inputs.text: An Indiana judge has blocked a law meant to protect unborn life after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened religious belief. Religious liberty matters, but it should not become a slogan for making abortion access immune from any limits. A decent society has obligations beyond individual preference—especially toward the most vulnerable. The question is not whether autonomy matters; it is whether it must always outweigh the duty to defend life.
